# Write-free e2e: plan (authoritative dry run) — schema, verify modes, sha stability.

# Text summary includes project + plan_sha256 + verify mode + file/deps lists.
exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml
stdout 'plan:'
stdout 'project=minimal-cli'
stdout 'plan_sha256='
stdout 'verify: default'
stdout 'files: 21'
stdout 'dependencies:'
stdout 'external_steps:'
stdout 'go_pin:'
! stderr .
dump_digest stdout

# JSON schema 1 Generation Plan document inside envelope.
exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output json
stdout '"schema":1'
stdout '"command":"plan"'
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"plan_sha256"'
stdout '"external_steps"'
stdout '"verification"'
stdout '"files"'
! stderr .
cp stdout plan_default.json
dump_digest plan_default.json

# plan_sha256 stable across two consecutive runs in the same workdir/env.
exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output json
cp stdout plan_default_2.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_default.json plan_default_2.json

# --verify strict differs from default (step list + plan_sha256).
exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --verify strict --output json
stdout '"mode":"strict"'
stdout 'go-staticcheck'
stdout 'go-govulncheck'
! stderr .
cp stdout plan_strict.json
assert_plan_sha256_ne plan_default.json plan_strict.json

# validate and plan share pipeline: same plan_sha256 for same fixture.
exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --output json
cp stdout validate.json
assert_plan_sha256_eq plan_default.json validate.json

# TUI plans (catalog present).
exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-tui.toml
stdout 'plan:'
stdout 'plan_sha256='
! stderr .

# Invalid plan fails with exact id (same path as validate).
! exec foundry plan --spec examples/invalid-unknown-field.toml
stderr 'spec.unknown_field'
assert_error_id stderr spec.unknown_field

# dest override is non-binding: no directory created under $WORK/out.
mkdir out
exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest ./out/minimal-cli
stdout 'plan:'
! exists out/minimal-cli
list_tree out
